svg.title: The products on the two choices
svg.desc: A grid. Rows say who writes the memory: the user; the model, during its turn; a process after or between conversations; nobody. Columns say how it is read: all of it put into the prompt, a search that selects, or not documented. The user writes: CLAUDE.md files in Claude Code and saved info in Gemini are inserted. The model during its turn: ChatGPT's saved memories, Claude Code's MEMORY.md index and Gemini CLI's memory files are inserted; Claude Code's topic files, Gemini CLI's detail files and the API memory tool are read on demand, and Le Chat recalls its Memories when relevant; the Claude app's topics and Meta AI are not documented. A process writes: ChatGPT's dreaming summary, Codex's memory summary, Mastra's Observational Memory and the Claude app's earlier daily summary are inserted; Codex's rollout summaries are read on demand. Nobody writes: Claude's search over past chats, Grok's referenced chats and Gemini's Personal Intelligence search what is already there. Not documented who writes: Perplexity searches its memory store; Gemini's memory of past chats is not documented either way.
svg.text: The products on the two choices
Who writes the memory, and whether all of it goes into the prompt or a search picks part of it. One product can sit in
several cells: Claude Code loads its index and reads its topic files on demand.
a search or a tool picks part of it
a tool call or a file edit,
the vendor's published code or prompt
Placements and sources: part 9 of the series, as of November 2026
